_help: One entry per file in /slides. Every field is optional: title, caption, alt, taken (YYYY-MM-DD), camera, lens, focal35 (mm, 35 mm equivalent), aperture, shutter, iso (the editor at /edit/ fills these from the photo; scripts/photo-meta.mjs recovers them for older photos), video (a YouTube link: the photograph becomes its still, and the player loads only when someone presses play), tags ("120" = the 120.media set, "luma" and "nova" = that dog is in it; either puts it in the Luma & Nova set), featured (shown on the home page before 'Show all'), order (number; higher shows first), taken (YYYY-MM-DD) and camera (both override what content/photo-meta.json recovered from the original; the /edit/ editor fills them in for a new photo). A new .webp dropped into /slides appears automatically, newest number first, even with no entry here.
